ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels to high-intensity white/yellowish-white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular contiguous yellowish-white patches located on the proximal-lateral regions of both left and right lobes. Central and distal regions are predominantly black with high-frequency white speckling/mottling distributed throughout.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees and a relative depth extending roughly 15% into the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration with peaks ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in height; the left lobe displays more jagged, irregular topography compared to the slightly smoother right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges tapering to acute, upward-pointing tips; the trailing edge follows a complex concave-to-convex S-curve toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular, high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel clusters (ranging 10-30 pixels in diameter) concentrated in the central-right lobe and scattered across the black pigmentation, indicative of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, multi-directional light-colored linear streaks; notably a long diagonal abrasion on the left lobe and shorter vertical scratches in the central fluke region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and associated scarring on both lobe tips and along the trailing edges; presence of multiple circular 'cookie-cutter' style scars of varying ages.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan hue within the primary white pigmentation zones, distinct from the pure white focal spots.
